internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:23 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the cart service. The error rate reached 0.5, significantly above the threshold of 0.05. Initial diagnosis confirmed error injection within the cart service as the primary fault. The checkout service also showed elevated errors but was secondary to the cart service issue.

The remediation involved disabling a specific flag related to the cart service failure at 11:43 UTC after approval from the second on-call engineer. Post-action monitoring confirmed the error rate dropped to normal levels (0.002), verifying recovery.

No resource exhaustion, memory leaks, or latency issues were detected during the incident. The frontend service was inconclusive as a contributing factor.

This incident was resolved within 20 minutes from alert to recovery verification.

Our engineering team identified and resolved the issue promptly, restoring normal service. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
